purpose: Commission the actual compiled S169 quadruped, batched contacts and bounded feedback controls before experimental candidate training.
initialization: Fresh model default pose and zero velocities except seeded native-Y torso velocity in [-0.005,0.005]. GPU explicitly projects pose and velocity to float32. No cached physical baseline.
sampling: Every internal step: before/after native qpos/qvel, applied controls, completed-step named actuator/joint forces, force-cap branch labels, completed-solve contacts with native indices and world ids, native time, overflow bits and constraint counts. Contacts and force sensors describe the force-evaluation state; post-step root pose is read directly from qpos. Never label stale xpos as post-state pose or generalized momentum as motor impulse.
coverage: named force identity and clamp labels
fresh CPU challenge of all four identical feedback policies
not_covered: qualified portable walking controller on GPU
